propositions: Silent sub-op failures and swallowed comment_errors are recorded non-fatally and never counted in mutation_failures, causing reconciliation to report OK and exit 0 despite partial sync failures.
comment_errors (partial Jira comment failures) are demoted to non-fatal at the acli_subprocess transport layer and do not propagate to the reconciler outcome.
The silent-no-op canary only hard-fails behind RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP flag (default off), leaving silent failures invisible by default.
When RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP is enabled, partial comment drops should set outcome[error] and count toward mutation_failures to drive non-zero pass exit.
Flag activation must be sequenced after Jira comment cleanup (ticket bd80) to avoid false failures on still-capped tickets.
The silent-no-op canary previously covered only links; it must be augmented to also cover comments and labels.
